name: offer_builder
description: Gather and structure compensation justification data for offer approval. Pulls candidate profile, interview scorecard signals, aggregate team comp parity, and any competing offer the candidate voluntarily disclosed in ATS recruiter notes. Never uses a candidate's current or prior pay. Produces an in-chat justification summary for internal approval. Use when: offer approval, comp justification, competing offer, comp parity. Triggers: offer justification, comp justification, offer approval, comp parity, competing offer [candidate], offer summary for [candidate]. Do NOT use for: candidate-facing offer letters, bulk compensation analysis, or summarizing interview feedback alone (use interview_debrief).
